hints.title: Prefix Subarray Conditions
hints.text: Notice that for nums1 to be a prefix of nums2, the length of nums2 must be at least that of nums1, and their initial elements must match.

hints.title: Prefix Match Precomputation
hints.text: Compute longest common prefix lengths for all suffix pairs (i, j) in quadratic time.

hints.title: Split Point Check
hints.text: Iterate through all pairs (i, j) and check whether either condition holds in constant time using the prefix match table.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Z-algorithm or longest common prefix precomputations evaluate prefix conditions for each split pair in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iteratively comparing subarrays for every candidate split takes cubic O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) prefix match table precomputed in quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Preprocesses prefix match lengths to verify beautiful split constraints in constant time per split.
